row.notes: VEHICLE PERFORMANCE COMPARISON refresh (Team HQ hub and R&D page; callers 0x1418130b0 (the comparison's constructor, rcx = this) and 0x141f40690 (rcx = [rsi+0x960])): zeroes the count (+0x38) and copies 20 entries to +0x40 (0x14 each: team key +0, driver key +4, value +8; keys prefilled 0x3fff0000), then switches on the mode +0x1d0 (0..4, other values return). Modes 0..3 fill the entries with 0x141890e60; modes 1..3 sort them (0x14194d970, or 0x14194c840 when +0x1f7, which asserts through 0x14029b020 when +0x218 is clear); mode 2 keeps the first 3, mode 3 keeps a 3-entry window around the player team; mode 4 computes inline for the player team only (model key == +0x1d4) and sets the count to 1. Every mode ends with a tail jmp to 0x1418914f0 (the R&D performance panel) with rcx = the comparison. 0x141890e60 walks the UpgradesComponent at +0x10 (models +0x298..+0x2a0): per team value = sum of the type metadata rating base (model +0x1a38 entries +0xc, only entries whose department +1 equals +0x1d8 unless +0x1d8 is 5) + 0x143518350 (all departments) or 0x143518660 (one department), the completed upgrades' share of (rating_full +0x10 - rating_base +0xc); the player's team (+0x1f7 and key == +0x1d4/+0x1d6) per driver through 0x143522910 with the driver key at +4. Verifier corrections V1088 folded in.

verify.notes: V1088 Independently confirmed: 0x141890990 is a func start (push rsi/push rdi/sub rsp,0x1c8; sigcheck 1/1 hits=1), single arg rcx=comparison, zeroes +0x38 and memcpys 20x0x14 entries (keys 0x3fff0000) to +0x40, jump table on +0x1d0 (0..4, else plain ret); 0x141890e60 sums model +0x1a38 entries +0xc (dept byte +1 vs +0x1d8, 5=all) + 0x143518350/0x143518660 per team, per driver via 0x143522910 for the player team; xref.py lists exactly the two calls (rcx=this in ctor 0x1418130b0, rcx=[rsi+0x960] in 0x141f40690). Corrections: mode 4 does not call 0x141890e60 (inline, player team only, count=1), mode 0 does not sort, mode 3 keeps a 3-entry window around the player team, and modes 0..4 end with a tail jmp to 0x1418914f0 (rcx=comparison) that the notes omit.
